title: Niagara County's shared sales tax, 2024: the county's line and its recipients' own filings
notice: Two independent sets of books for ONE pot of money: the county's single unlabeled line (record county_line) and the 20 governments' own filings of what they received (record recipient_own_filing) - they differ by 0.14%. Never add the two together. Niagara Falls's separate city sales tax is not part of this pot and is not in this file. Self-reported annual filings to the NYS Comptroller: desk-reviewed by the Office of the State Comptroller, not audited. Figures as filed, no inflation adjustment, no year interpolated (a year with no filing is absent, never zero). The reporting basis changed in 2013: figures on either side of it are not strictly comparable.
